name: node-opcua-crypto-web
description: Pre-bundled, zero-config browser build of node-opcua-crypto
//why: This package exists so node-opcua-crypto can stay lean for Node. The pre-bundled browser build inlines its polyfills (crypto-browserify, stream-browserify, ...) and weighs ~344 KB gzip - more than the entire node-opcua-crypto tarball. Shipping it there would make every Node consumer download a browser bundle they never import. Browser consumers install this package explicitly, or let node-opcua-crypto's "browser" export condition redirect to it (see node-opcua-crypto/browser/index.js).
//exports: there is no "require" condition on purpose: this is an ESM-only browser bundle with no .cjs counterpart, so a single shared "types" key is correct here and cannot produce the CJS-gets-ESM-types hazard (attw FalseESM) that node-opcua-crypto's map guards against.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:types

author: Etienne Rossignon
//devDependencies: every one of these is inlined into dist/ at build time (tsup noExternal), so this package has no runtime dependencies at all.
//files: the .map is excluded deliberately: it gzips to ~662 KB, nearly twice the bundle itself and ~65% of the tarball. The bundle is not minified, so it stays readable without one. index_web.d.cts is excluded for the same reason - there is no CJS build for it to describe. Both are still generated locally for debugging.
